## [1.1.4](https://github.com/CappyT/cappys-patches/compare/v1.1.3...v1.1.4) (2026-10-15)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* block Play Store in-app review flow that nags sideloaded installs ([3960b06](https://github.com/CappyT/cappys-patches/commit/3960b060a8d4b7f9791abe8b3c174c15b9e103f4))

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Disables Sentry crash reporting, AppsFlyer attribution and Firebase Analytics collection.

patches.name: Fix Google Play detection
patches.description: Disables pairipcore's license and signature checks that complain the app was not installed from Google Play and shut it down.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks MuseScore Pro / Off-Scores entitlements by patching the React Native Hermes bundle (paywalls, offline scores gating, feature flags). Also hides the device-compatibility attestation popup shown when opening scores.
